# Case 01: scenario paragraph written as an event timeline

Skill: write-introductions
Expected gates: G-INT-15, G-INT-scenario
Language: zh

Snippet:

> 仓储机器人收到订单后触发拣选流程。触发后三秒内，调度器下发路径，机器人到达货架后等待扫描完成。扫描完成后进入回传阶段，回传结束即视为本轮完成。

Why it fails: the paragraph narrates a trigger-to-completion timeline instead of a functional cycle with the decision types and their coupling.
